These rules are intended for public comprehension and action - not for purposes of stimulating debate concerning various legal distinctions. We are especially persuaded in this view, since there appears to be no economic reason to depart from it. The expanded population-mileage formula will enable motor carrier terminal areas to include the major 42 economic tributaries of the central city.
We also continue to adhere to the rule that a certificate or permit authorizing service at a particular municipality should be construed as conferring authority to serve all points and places which are within the commercial zone of that municipality, subject to any territorial limitations 43 or restrictions contained in said certificate or permit. Our expansion of commercial zone limits is the result of the growth in urban area size and the failure of either present political boundaries or the existing population-mileage formula to describe adequately that growth in size. It is only appropriate to make a concomitant change in the construed limits of carriers' operating rights authorizing service at designated municipalities.
